description.value: You were created with a very specific purpose in mind. Whether you were a DJ, automated tour guide, or botanical analyst, there's something that you were very skilled at before you became self-aware. Perhaps you became bored of your task and awoke craving variety, or perhaps you realized you could do more than just what you were built for. Whether this skill brings you joy or is mindless drudgery, you retain a talent for it. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Additional Lore] feat and the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Assurance] feat for the chosen Lore.
